newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle market steady $107/dressed - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle market steady $107/dressed - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Wednesday traded in moderate volume at $106.00-$107.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady with last week, market sources said.
About 10,000 head sold, including live basis sales at $66.00, which were steady to $1.00 lower than last week.
"They're trading fairly well at the current prices," one source said.
Feedlots had initially priced cattle at $108.00 on a dressed basis and $67 on a live basis, the sources said.
